Summary: Arcadia Sourceworks is evaluating Redwood for an internal code-search + RAG platform. Primary concerns: index scale (15-40M file objects), frequent re-indexing (near-real-time for main repo branches, nightly full index), top-k latency (50-150ms target for first-stage ANN + 10-50ms for reranker), and predictable cost per query. Use-case specifics: engineers + security team run code search, policy search, and cross-repo dependency lookups. Using heavy binary artifacts and monorepos; many small files and code snippets.

Architecture preferences and constraints: prefer VPC/Dedicated or Private deployment; SSO/SAML mandatory (Okta). Need audit logs for every query and admin-level exportability. They will keep source code tokens for 30 days, raw code blobs must remain in customer-managed storage for compliance.

Current infra and ingestion: Kafka topics for repo events, Airflow pipelines for incremental embedding jobs, nightly batch for full rebuilds, owners estimate 3-6TB embedding store (float16/quant) for 25M vectors. They want ability to do delta embeddings on push and a rolling snapshot for reproducible reranks. Ask for guidance on shard sizing and recommended vector store (hosted vs Dedicated).

Performance / cost targets: cost-sensitive on per-query basis (goal <$0.002/query at 95th for typical two-stage flow). Latency SLOs: p95 <= 200ms for end-to-end code search rerank; ideal p50 < 100ms. Throughput: peak 600 qps across internal tools.

Model preferences: open-code embedding model or Redwood-verified code embeddings; prefer 1536-4096d vectors if quantization keeps quality. Reranker: lightweight cross-encoder on a smaller context window for top-50 results. Need recommendations on batching vs caching (prefix reuse when dev workflows repeat queries).

Security / compliance notes: vendor questionnaire under review (drive:/Arcadia/security-qa-2025-02-12.md). Legal flagged data residency for EU customers; medical/financial customers require air-gapped option. KMS integration required, HSM optional.
